Source acceptance checks actual PLAN/BUILD_VERIFICATION/source review pins, all planned after pins, build PDF pins, 151 compiler inputs and 47 complete witnesses; lazy fitz use reads the already built PDF without importing a builder.
Stage records every source file and verifies every copied byte, retains the original README in named history, and writes a current edition README.
Seal revalidates accepted source, staged source/file pins, final visual/PDF/QA acceptance, and evidence pins; the ZIP is checked for exact member set, CRC and every member byte/hash.
The package remains the fixed R62 source extent. Internal owner/provenance payload requires later publisher transformations as explicitly described; no remote operation exists.
crosswalk_review: prior_fixed_crosswalk validates immutable v15 SOURCE against the previous transport fixed_cut, and validates previous transport path and working_after agreement with promoted_files.after.
candidates always inserts CROSSWALK. preflight dispatches CROSSWALK unconditionally before generic allowed-pin acceptance, so an old allowed promotion.after cannot discard its 586-byte FC tail.
Current and new crosswalk bytes are rechecked against their just-read pins, and both must extend the immutable v15 SOURCE byte prefix exactly.

The strongest already present prefix is the new fixed cut when present and the old fixed SOURCE otherwise. All bytes after it are retained; empty suffixes are accepted. No text decoding, newline conversion, substring suppression or mathematical normalization occurs.

A repeated preflight of new fixed cut plus retained FC/Holonomy suffix returns the same bytes. Missing crosswalk or edits within the required fixed prefix reject. Prefix checking does not authenticate the authorship or chronology of arbitrary suffix contents.
promotion_review: Existing release_ directories, exact current_source_ packages and root Split_Zero_*.zip archives are rejected as current-file mutation targets.
All actual candidate conflicts are computed before current mutation. Each current pin is rechecked before its backup/write; each source copy and current destination is verified after writing.

Prior v8/v15 source-workspace and exact-package PDF/main pins plus both source ZIP pins were independently verified (ten files); all passed. The script rechecks preserved editions before and after promotion.

The fixed package manifest/member pins and archive hash must still match sealing. Current compiled/witness closure, PDF, frozen baseline, prior immutable crosswalk and preserved edition pins are rechecked after promotion.

An existing promotion backup rejects a repeated mutation run; readonly preflight remains separate. Partial failure retains its prepared metadata and per-file backups for diagnosis rather than claiming completion.
